local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local self=require('openmw.self')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local frames=0
local initial=false
local vanity=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frames=frames+1
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died in idle camera check')
 if frames>=5 and not initial then
  initial=true
  assert(camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson,'Input save must restore first person')
  print('Idle view initial first person')
 end
 if initial and camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.Vanity and not vanity then
  vanity=true print('Idle view vanity active')
 end
end}}}}
